description: Choose a composition's 3D renderer (Composition Settings > 3D Renderer: Classic 3D, Advanced 3D or Cinema 4D) and turn Draft 3D on or off (Composition panel). With no settings it reports the renderer, the installed renderers, Draft 3D and the active camera

comp.description: Which composition. Give its item id (from list_items) or name; omit for the active composition

draft3d.description: Draft 3D: preview the scene in real time at draft quality

renderer.description: classic_3d, advanced_3d, cinema_4d, or a renderer id from this tool's renderers list

name: set_comp_3d_settings
title: Set Comp 3d Settings
